description: Parameters of the Inner Control part of the REECB model in PSS/E.

PQ_Flag.description: PQ Flag used for the Current Limit Logic.

Vdip_lim.description: Limits for Voltage Dip Logic `(Vdip, Vup)`.

T_rv.description: Voltage Filter Time Constant. Units: s.

K_qv.description: Reactive current injection gain during over and undervoltage conditions.

V_ref0.description: User defined reference. If 0, `PowerSimulationsDynamics.jl` initializes to initial terminal voltage.

K_vp.description: Voltage regulator proportional gain (used when QFlag = 1).

K_vi.description: Voltage regulator integral gain (used when QFlag = 1).

T_iq.description: Time constant for low-pass filter for state q_V when QFlag = 0. Units: s.

I_max.description: Maximum limit on total converter current.

title: RECurrentControlB
